instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/history.ts` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. History.getTargetPageId (line ~157-166, added last round) crashes: TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'values') at history.ts:158 `delta.elements.inserted.values()` — called from History.record (line ~172). This breaks pages.test.tsx 'select-all and click selection ignore other pages' and 'puts new elements on the active page'. ElementsDelta has NO `inserted`/`deleted` maps: its fields are `added`, `removed` and `updated`, each `Record<string, Delta<ElementPartial>>` keyed by element id (packages/element/src/delta.ts ~line 1042), and an `updated` partial carries only the changed props (e.g. x, version), NOT pageId. Rewrite getTargetPageId: collect the element ids from Object.keys(delta.elements.added), .removed and .updated; for each id find the element in `this.store.snapshot.elements.get(id)` (the snapshot holds every page's elements) and, if missing, read `pageId` from the delta's own `inserted`/`deleted` partials (`delta.elements.added[id].inserted.pageId` etc.); return getElementPageId({ pageId }) of the first element found; when the delta changes no elements (appState-only, e.g. selection) return this.activePageId. Keep everything else in history.ts as is. Test that must pass: packages/excalidraw/tests/pages.test.tsx 'keeps undo on its page' (r1 moved on the default page, r2 moved on page 2, back on the default page undo must set r1.x back to 0 and leave r2.x at 1).

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/history.ts", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/history.ts", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
